# Starlight sidebar

Confirm each signature with `consult-astro-docs` before writing. This file is the shapes and the gotchas.

## Autogenerated by default

With no `sidebar` key, Starlight builds the whole sidebar from the tree under `src/content/docs/`, labelling each entry with the page's `title`. Configure one when the order or the grouping has to differ from the directory layout.

## Entry shapes

A configured `sidebar` is an array of these:

- a bare slug string — `'guides/intro'`
- `{ slug }` — the same entry, with room for a `label` or `badge` override
- `{ label, link }` — anything outside the docs collection, including external URLs
- `{ label, items }` — a group

`autogenerate` is its own entry inside a group's `items`:

```js
sidebar: [
  { label: 'Guides', items: [{ label: 'Start here', slug: 'guides/intro' }, { autogenerate: { directory: 'guides' } }] },
]
```

So one group mixes hand-written and generated links freely.

## Badges

`badge` takes a string or `{ text, variant, class }`. The variants are `note`, `tip`, `danger`, `caution`, `success`, and `default`.

## Per-page overrides

`sidebar` frontmatter on a page carries `label`, `order`, `badge`, `hidden`, and `attrs`:

```md
---
title: Advanced routing
sidebar:
  order: 2
  badge: New
---
```

These reach autogenerated and `slug` entries. A `link` entry takes its label and badge from the config instead, so set them there.
